notes.add.statement: INSERT INTO notes (user_id, body, remind_at) VALUES (?1, ?2, ?3)

notes.inbox.statement: SELECT id, body, remind_at, surfaced_at FROM notes WHERE user_id = ?1 AND surfaced_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY surfaced_at DESC, id LIMIT 50

notes.surface.statement: UPDATE notes SET surfaced_at = ?1 WHERE surfaced_at IS NULL AND remind_at <= ?1

notify.subject: Notes are due
notify.body: Open your notes to read the reminders.
